scripts.dev: pnpm build:slides && concurrently -n astro,slides "astro dev --host" "pnpm dev:slides"
scripts.deploy: pnpm build:slides && astro build && firebase deploy --only=hosting
scripts.build:slides: rm -rf ./public/slides/; for d in slides/*/slides.md; do SLIDE=$(basename $(dirname $d)) pnpm build:slide; done
